### 2.0 Load enriched terms

- Let's first include the reactivity gene expression matrix and the supplied experiment matrix.

```{r include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

go_bp_enriched_terms_df <- readRDS(file.path(rdata_dir, "03_erap2_overexpression_go_bp_GSEA_pval_0.05.rds"))
go_bp_enriched_terms_df$database <- "GO:BP"

go_mf_enriched_terms_df <- readRDS(file.path(rdata_dir, "03_erap2_overexpression_go_mf_GSEA_pval_0.05.rds"))
go_mf_enriched_terms_df$database <- "GO:MF"

go_cc_enriched_terms_df <- readRDS(file.path(rdata_dir, "03_erap2_overexpression_go_cc_GSEA_pval_0.05.rds"))
go_cc_enriched_terms_df$database <- "GO:CC"

hpo_enriched_terms_df <- readRDS(file.path(rdata_dir, "03_erap2_overexpression_hpo_GSEA_pval_0.05.rds"))
hpo_enriched_terms_df$database <- "HPO"

reactome_enriched_terms_df <- readRDS(file.path(rdata_dir, "03_erap2_overexpression_reactome_GSEA_pval_0.05.rds"))
reactome_enriched_terms_df$database <- "Reactome"

biocarta_enriched_terms_df <- readRDS(file.path(rdata_dir, "03_erap2_overexpression_biocarta_GSEA_pval_0.05.rds"))
biocarta_enriched_terms_df$database <- "Biocarta"

hallmark_enriched_terms_df <- readRDS(file.path(rdata_dir, "03_erap2_overexpression_hallmark_GSEA_pval_0.05.rds"))    
hallmark_enriched_terms_df$database <- "Hallmark"



all_enriched_terms_df <- rbind(hallmark_enriched_terms_df, go_bp_enriched_terms_df, go_mf_enriched_terms_df,
    go_cc_enriched_terms_df, hpo_enriched_terms_df, reactome_enriched_terms_df, biocarta_enriched_terms_df)


all_enriched_terms_df <- all_enriched_terms_df[all_enriched_terms_df$contrast == "erap2_overexpression_effect",]
all_enriched_terms_df_split <- split(all_enriched_terms_df, paste( all_enriched_terms_df$database, sep = "_"))


```

### 3.0 Plot NES

- Plot the normalised enrichment scores for pathways with at leas


```{r}

pdf(file.path(plot_dir, paste(output_prefix(), "03_erap2_overexpression_all_databases_gsea_results_only_erap2_effect.pdf", sep = "_")), height = 12, width = 12)
lapply(all_enriched_terms_df_split, function(plot_df){
    a_db <- unique(plot_df$database)
    if(nrow(plot_df) > 50){
        message(a_db)
        
    }
    plot_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(plot_df, plot_df$contrast), function(temp_df){
        temp_df[order(temp_df$NES, decreasing = F),][1:min(30, nrow(temp_df)),]
    }))
    all_nes <- vapply(split(plot_df$NES, plot_df$pathway), function(x){ x[which.max(abs(x))]},1)
    plot_df$pathway <- factor(plot_df$pathway, levels = names(all_nes)[order(all_nes, decreasing = T)])

    ThePlot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = NES, y = pathway))
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, lty = "dashed", colour = "#000000")
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_point(aes(fill = contrast), shape = 21, size = 4, alpha = 0.6, colour = "#000000")
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_x_continuous("Normalised Enrichment Score")
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_y_discrete("pathways")
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_fill_brewer("contrasts", palette = "Set1")
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + ggtitle(paste(a_db))
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + scale_shape_manual("databases", values = c(21,22,23,24,25))
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + theme_bw()
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + facet_grid(. ~ contrast)
    ThePlot <- ThePlot + theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
            linetype = "dashed", size = 0.2))
})
dev.off()

```
